title: Enlargements or additions to existing system.
officialText:
Where there is an enlargement that triggers a new standpipe
system or there is an addition to an existing standpipe system, hydrostatic pressure tests of the entire system shall be performed
for every 75 feet (22 860 mm) of additional height added to the system. The permit holder shall perform a final acceptance test
of the completed system in accordance with the requirements of Section 901.5 of this code.
